Create a premium art-directed visual storyboard for an AI Receptionist marketing website hero. One square 1:1 image, ideally 2048x2048, divided into exactly FOUR equal square panels in a seamless 2x2 grid (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right), with NO gutters, NO borders, NO panel numbers, NO captions outside the devices, NO watermark. Each quadrant is an independent cinematic keyframe of the SAME scene/world progressing through time, with consistent objects and lighting. Extremely polished high-end 3D product film quality, convincing physical textures, deliberate composition, memorable dramatic lighting. This is a comparison concept, not a screenshot of an existing site. Render only a few short readable UI words specified below; do not generate long fake text. The service accepts online bookings and places outbound confirmation calls, then shows the business owner an outcome. Do not show incoming-call handling, external calendar synchronization, robot faces, or people with headsets.

Very high-end restrained editorial photography, natural stone grain and metal reflections. Four clean independent square shots: TOP LEFT establishing three-quarter product shot of the phone showing a simple appointment selection screen, minimal exact words "Book a visit", elegantly surrounded by negative space. TOP RIGHT camera much closer: a glass-like appointment card visibly lifts a short distance out of the phone display, exact words "Booking received". BOTTOM LEFT close cinematic view: the same floating card unfolds into an outgoing call interface and sculptural cobalt audio waveform, exact words "Calling client". BOTTOM RIGHT camera pulls wider: a slim open laptop sits next to the same phone on the same counter, showing a beautifully restrained owner dashboard with a checkmark and exact word "Confirmed", small summary lines drawn as shapes. No different studio or added people. Make each shot beautiful enough to be a standalone hero frame.
